#### Description

When using `GetWordAfterCursorWithSpace()` with multibyte characters (Japanese, Cyrillic, etc.), the function returns truncated text instead of the complete word. This appears to affect both the regular function and its space-inclusive variant.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```go
package main

import (
    "fmt"
    "github.com/c-bata/go-prompt"
)

func main() {
    // Test with Japanese characters
    doc := prompt.NewDocument("hello かきくけこ world", 6)
    result := doc.GetWordAfterCursorWithSpace()
    fmt.Printf("Expected: ' かきくけこ'\n")
    fmt.Printf("Got: '%s'\n", result)
    
    // Test with Cyrillic characters  
    doc2 := prompt.NewDocument("hello день world", 6)
    result2 := doc2.GetWordAfterCursorWithSpace()
    fmt.Printf("Expected: ' день'\n")
    fmt.Printf("Got: '%s'\n", result2)
}
```

The function should return the complete word including multibyte characters, but instead returns partial/corrupted text like " かきくけ\xe3\x81" instead of " かきくけこ" and " ден\xd1" instead of " день".
